question: Dakshinamurthy Pillai was an Indian musician who used to play __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mridangam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Dakshinamurthy Pillai** was a renowned Indian musician known for his exceptional mastery of the **Mridangam**, a traditional South Indian percussion instrument.
 
• He belonged to the Carnatic music tradition and contributed significantly to enhancing the role of rhythm in classical music performances.
